# Contributing

Thanks for helping. Useful contributions: new read-only collectors (for example macOS, Google Workspace,
GCP, Kubernetes), better derived checks, corrections to the control mapping, and documentation.

## Ground rules

* **Read-only, always.** A collector reads configuration and writes one evidence file. Nothing else.
  No credentials are stored, no secrets, hashes, recovery keys or tokens appear in the output.
* **Fictional data only.** `examples/` is generated by `scripts/build_examples.py` from invented data
  (Northwind Logistics, Contoso, Fabrikam). Never commit real output, real hostnames, tenant or account ids.
* **Same envelope, same hash scheme** in every language. If you touch `lib/`, change all three
  implementations and run the cross-language round-trip (below).
* **Standards by reference only.** Use identifiers (`ISO27001:A.8.8`, `CIS8:7.3`) and your own words; do not
  paste standard text.
* Be kind — see the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Adding a collector

1. Copy the closest existing collector in `collectors/<family>/` and keep its header (synopsis, requirements,
   impact `Read-only`, controls, licence).
2. Build `data` as an ordered structure with a `summary` an auditor can read without scrolling. Record
   errors per step (`Invoke-EvidenceStep`, `evidence_command`, `try/except`) so one missing privilege does
   not lose the rest.
3. Call the helper to write the envelope: `New-EvidenceEnvelope` + `Write-Evidence`, `evidence_write`, or
   `build_envelope` + `write_evidence`.
4. Add a row to `docs/control-mapping.md` and a fictional sample to `scripts/build_examples.py`.
5. Run the checks below, then open a pull request.

## Checks that CI runs (run them locally first)

```powershell
# Windows / PowerShell 7
Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.ps1 | ForEach-Object { $t=$null; $e=$null
  [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($_.FullName, [ref]$t, [ref]$e) | Out-Null
  if ($e) { throw "$($_.Name): $($e[0].Message)" } }
Import-Module ./lib/Evidence.psm1 -Force
Get-ChildItem examples/*.json | Test-Evidence | Where-Object { -not $_.Valid }   # must print nothing
```

```bash
# Linux / macOS
shellcheck -x -P SCRIPTDIR -S style lib/evidence.sh collectors/linux/*.sh
python -m pyflakes lib/*.py scripts/*.py collectors/cloud/*.py
python -m py_compile lib/evidence.py scripts/*.py collectors/cloud/*.py
python scripts/build_examples.py && git diff --exit-code -- examples/
python scripts/verify_evidence.py examples/
```

Cross-language round-trip: write an envelope with one implementation and verify it with the other two
(`Test-Evidence`, `evidence_verify`, `verify_evidence.py`). CI does this on every push.

## Style notes

* PowerShell: comment-based help, `[CmdletBinding()]`, `$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"`, approved verbs,
  works on Windows PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7 (no ternary, no `??`).
* Bash: `set -u`, quote everything, no `jq` dependency, shellcheck clean.
* Python: `#!/usr/bin/env python3`, `from __future__ import annotations`, type hints, standard library plus the
  one SDK the collector needs, imported inside a `try` with a clear message.
* Timestamps are UTC ISO 8601 (`2026-10-15T09:30:00Z`); file names are `<collector>_<host>_<timestamp>.json`.
